description: Create a recurring calendar event with configurable recurrence rules.

organizer_id.description: User ID of the event organizer

start_datetime.description: ISO8601 datetime for the first occurrence

duration_minutes.description: Duration of each occurrence in minutes; must be positive

frequency.description: Recurrence frequency: daily, weekly, or monthly

interval.description: Interval between occurrences; must be positive

end_type.description: How the recurrence ends: count, date, or never

count.description: Number of occurrences; required when end_type is count

end_date.description: ISO8601 date after which no more occurrences are created; required when end_type is date

attendees.description: Optional list of attendees with their roles and notification preferences

name.description: Optional display name of the attendee

role.description: Attendee role: required, optional, or organizer

notify.description: Whether to send this attendee an invitation and event updates

provider.description: Conferencing provider: zoom, teams, meet, or custom

auto_create.description: If true, automatically create a meeting link via the provider's API

dial_in_numbers.description: Optional list of dial-in phone numbers for participants without internet access

country.description: Country name or ISO code for this dial-in number

reminders.description: Optional list of reminders to send before each occurrence

minutes_before.description: Number of minutes before the event start to send this reminder

channels.description: Channels for this reminder: email, sms, or push

exceptions.description: Optional list of ISO8601 dates on which the recurring event should be skipped

visibility.description: Optional event visibility: public, private, or tentative

color.description: Optional hex colour code for calendar display (e.g. #FF5733)

categories.description: Optional list of category labels for the event

end_datetime.description: Optional ISO8601 datetime; if provided, overrides duration_minutes for the last occurrence
